identity.name: Old Palm Golf Club
identity.notes: Luxury gated golf community in Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418, featuring a Raymond Floyd-designed 18-hole championship course on ~650 acres with ~316 homesites. Governed by Old Palm Foundation, Inc. (management involves RealManage), with a separate Old Palm Community Development District (CDD) handling infrastructure. Club membership is often required and is separate from POA fees.

fees.note: POA fees reported in listings as approximately $1,970-$2,304/month (some sources cite $2,000-$3,000 range), varying by property; separate from club membership fees. Exact current amounts require direct association verification by address. Management involves RealManage; full current details unavailable without direct association contact. (Aggregator source - moderate confidence.)

CDD assessments appear on property tax bills; maintenance portion around $2,094-$2,383 per unit in recent years, plus debt service varying by parcel. Exact current amounts unavailable without specific address verification. (Aggregator source - moderate confidence.)

HOA fee reported as $25,104/year (second-highest in the PBG corridor); covers common-area landscaping, gated security, road maintenance, and access to club amenities. Does NOT include annual club dues, food & beverage minimums, or golf cart fees (separate club charges). Total annual carrying cost incl. HOA, property tax, club dues, F&B minimums, insurance estimated $130,000-$180,000 at market median home price. Source is a brokerage market guide, not the HOA itself - verify with association. (A search snippet from the same site also showed $28,164/year, but the page body attributes that figure to Frenchman's Creek, not Old Palm.)

POA fees reported in real estate listings as approximately $1,970-$2,304 per month (or quarterly equivalents), varying by property; some sources note $2,000-$3,000/month range. Amount shown is midpoint of the reported range. Separate from club membership fees. Exact current amounts require per-address verification with Old Palm Foundation, Inc. / RealManage.

Old Palm CDD levies assessments collected on property tax bills. Listings report maintenance portion around $2,094-$2,383 per unit in recent years, plus debt service varying by parcel. Amount shown is midpoint of reported maintenance range. The official 2024 CDD audit PDF on flauditor.gov returned a 404 and could not be verified directly.

Private club membership (Old Palm Golf Club) is often required for properties per membership plan and deed covenants, and is billed separately from POA fees (equity + annual dues + F&B minimums + golf cart fees). A 2024 club schedule PDF surfaced in search results (equity $350k, annual dues $38,500, renovation assessment $258.33/month for 20 years) but that page was not read/verified - see open_questions.

amenities.detail: 18-hole Raymond Floyd-designed championship course on ~650 acres; well-maintained greens and tropical landscaping (also confirmed by hoabulletinboard.com and hoa-community.com).
Clubhouse with dining and lounge rooms (also listed by hoa-community.com).
Community pool; resort-style features (also listed by luxury-communities.com and hoabulletinboard.com).
Fitness facility / gym-exercise room (also listed by luxury-communities.com).
Old Palm Golf Academy providing golf teaching and practice facilities to residents and members.
Raymond Floyd-designed 18-hole championship course on ~650 acres; community is golf-first; no marina and no private beach club
Clubhouse includes dining facilities, member events, dining programs, and seasonal social programming
Fitness center in the clubhouse; equipment/programming varies with management
Gated community; gated security funded by the HOA fee
Tennis courts listed among community facilities
Pet restrictions include leash requirements and breed considerations; short-term rentals restricted, long-term rentals may require approval; architectural review for exterior modifications

demographics.geography_level: city (Palm Beach Gardens, FL - the city containing the community; community/tract-level figures not retrieved)}

open_questions: Proximity: could not verify distances to nearest shopping, grocery, library, hospital, or school. Only verified fact is that the community is centrally located near I-95 and PGA Boulevard (hoabulletinboard). No page read provided specific facility names or mileages.

Demographics: censusreporter page returned only city population (60,959) even with JS enabled; median age, median household income, and owner-occupancy % for Palm Beach Gardens (or the community's census tract) were not retrieved. Qualitative profile from the brokerage guide (practitioner observation, not census data): residents skew to executives/entrepreneurs in their 50s-60s and semi-retired/retired golf households; ~87% of transactions cash (95% in 2025); ~300 single-family estate homes, median home 7,352 sq ft; roughly half to two-thirds of households likely seasonal (primary residence elsewhere, present Oct-Apr).

Club membership costs: a 2024 Old Palm Golf Club schedule PDF (u.realgeeks.media) surfaced in search results stating membership equity $350k, 2024 annual dues $38,500, and a renovation assessment of $258.33/month for 20 years - NOT verified by reading the page; confirm with the club.

CDD assessment: official 2024 Old Palm CDD audit/budget PDF on flauditor.gov returned a 404; the $2,094-$2,383 maintenance figure comes from a listings aggregator (hoabulletinboard) and should be confirmed against the CDD's current budget (oldpalmcdd.com/auditbudgets) or the county property appraiser for a specific parcel.

Exact current POA fee per parcel: sources conflict between ~$1,970-$2,304/month (listings via hoabulletinboard) and $25,104/year (palmbeachluxury guide); verify with Old Palm Foundation, Inc. / RealManage (561-775-2120).
Whether club membership is currently required for all homesites or only per membership plan/deed covenants for newer properties.
